description:
Garrett O Bric Property Advisors are delighted to present 7 The Willows, a bright and well proportioned two bed apartment set in this highly regarded setting ideally positioned just off the Upper Dargle Road. The location is super set in an attractive established gated development with rolling manicured lawns only minutes walk from all amenities and services. The Egans Complex lies just beyond the entrance to Diamond Valley and is home to a range of shops including a well stocked Centra, a beauty salon, a general practice and chemist plus take away food outlets. The N11 is just a stones throw away providing speedy access to surrounding areas and the M50 taking you to Dublin and beyond. The area is well served by a range of Dublin Bus services and DART and rail services are close at hand in Bray town. 
Number 7 is set at a secure first floor location with access via lift or stairs with spacious light filled accommodation extending to 85.97 square metres presented in pristine condition and ready for immediate occupation. On entering number 7, the generous hallway immediately makes an impression with storage provided in four areas providing ample storage for everyday living. From here, the accommodation opens into a wonderful open plan living, dining and kitchen flooded with natural light. This spacious area provides plenty of room for relaxing, entertaining and cooking. The living room enjoys direct access to a wonderful balcony overlooking the manicured grounds while the kitchen is home to a super range of bespoke handcrafted cabinetry with integrated appliances perfect for all your cooking needs. There are two generous double bedrooms, the primary with ensuite shower room while a stunning bathroom completes the accommodation. This home boasts well proportioned accommodation ideal for modern living and early viewing is highly recommended to truly appreciate all number 7 has to offer.

Accommodation 

The block is access via a well maintained lobby with lift and stair access to the property. 

Entrance Hallway 
Welcoming hallway boasting four storage areas, one of which is home to the hotpress providing excellent linen storage, a second is home to your utilities while the two further storage areas provide an abundance of storage. At foot oak laminate timber flooring creates a practical yet stylish statement. 

Open Plan Living Room, Dining Room and Kitchen 
4.1 x 6.2m plus 2.4 x 2.4m 
This wonderful L Shaped open plan room boasts plenty of room for designated living, dining and cooking areas. An almost fully glazed wall with a door to the balcony bathes the room in natural light and overlooks the landscaped grounds below, bringing the outside inside perfectly. The living room area is centred around a feature fireplace with gas fire inset creating a warm and welcoming ambience. There is also plenty of space for a large dining table perfect for entertaining. The room is floored seamlessly with laminate timber flooring adding to the sense of space and light. The kitchen area is well equipped for all your cooking needs with an excellent range of Shaker style cabinetry providing an abundance of storage with built in oven, hob with extractor fan overhead and an integrated fridge freezer, an attractive splash back is tiled with a splash of colour for ease of maintenance. 

Primary Bedroom 
3.9 x 3.3m 
This wonderful bright spacious double bedroom features a superb picture window running almost from floor to ceiling. The room is complete with an excellent range of fitted wardrobes and is finished with cosy carpeting in a neutral shade. The room also features an ensuite shower room with wc, wash hand basin and shower facility. 

Bedroom No. 2
3.2 x 2.8m 
Again this spacious double bedroom is home to an excellent range of fitted wardrobes and boasts a picture window overlooking the grounds. 

Bathroom 
With high quality sanitary ware in classic white with wc, wash hand basin plus bath with shower facility overhead, the room boasts extensive tiling adding a touch of luxury. 

Outside

The block is set in landscaped grounds featuring rolling lawns and a variety of well tended shrubs and trees, with access via electric gates. There is ample underground parking for owners and visitors alike. Number 7 boasts a truly wonderful balcony located just off the living room perfect for entertaining or al fresco dining and with a wonderful open outlook across the landscaped grounds below.
